approval: M5 author approves exactly these portable payload bytes for Models publication; no private raw/code paths or prompts included.
scope: New immutable text-bound predicate; independent of prior JSON parser trials and software passes.
original_only_oracle: String is final. For nonempty UTF16 length<=32768, codePointCount<=32768 follows even before surrogate qualification. Keep the entire original surrogate walk and keep original code-point counting for all longer strings.
real_rejected_alternatives: Replacing the bound with only UTF16 length rejects32768 supplementary characters that were accepted before.
Fusing an early surrogate failure into counting changes the first error for an early unpaired surrogate followed by too many code points.
Latin1 code-point counting already returns a length difference in the pinned JDK source, so a blanket linear-scan speedup claim is false.
implementation: One executable literal proposed by an offline source agent, reviewed by parent; no local model HTTP or local model code contribution. No new methods, fields, imports, dependency types or class-family names.
source_proof: 75392 bounded Python source-model cases showed no difference; they are not Java test passes or OS/VM observations.
software: First one-TU compile0.732010s, two pre-existing family names, empty stdout/stderr, pins unchanged.0newTest/0RUN; a mirror test was deliberately not added for a pure predicate with no new behavioral boundary.
cost_limit: Overlapping windows are not added; compiler elapsed is not owner labour or OS CPU. Source discovery, review, preparation, scheduling and waiting stay in marked wall.
preparation_failure: The source agent initially assumed CRLF; its pre-mutation anchor assertion failed. Actual LF source was then used, and the failed assertion remains separately retained. No software compile or source mutation occurred in that failed preparation.
support_boundary: The exception support class was used only as an existing binary API; whole source-to-class and live loader mapping remain unknown.
no_performance_credit: Only structural UTF16 scan avoidance is established. Actual coder distribution, allocations, CPU, heap, GC, end-to-end wall and saved-day benefit are unmeasured; this is not a measured resolution of the larger planning delay.
